text:
maria (pm): Quick thread to align on the dataplane visibility sprint ask — core goal: give customers per-route cost/latency visibility + trace hooks for model fallbacks. Need prioritization and crisp launch criteria.

tariq (eng-runtime): +1. current constraint is KV cache visibility and token accounting gaps. we can ship a lightweight dashboard if we expose per-request meta from the runtime.

jin (eng-platform): what fields do we need from runtime? route_id, model_variant, token_count, token_cost_estimate, latency_ms, trace_id?

maria (pm): exactly. minimal schema: route, model, variant, tokens_in, tokens_out, compute_gpu_ms, latency_p50/p95, trace_id. customers want CSV export and per-customer breakdown.

sasha (eng-sre): we also need sampling controls for traces — full traces for canaries only, sampled for normal traffic. otherwise observability costs explode. :money_with_wings:

leo (cs): customer asks: (a) per-route token burn by day, (b) spike alerts when cost > baseline by 30%, (c) ability to map costs to workspace/team tags. several enterprise trials asked for an audit-friendly export (line items).

maria (pm): proposed MVP (6 weeks): 1) runtime emits minimal telemetry envelope; 2) platform ingests into short-term store and exposes dashboard; 3) per-route CSV export; 4) trace hook API + sampling policy UI. Ask: agree or trim.

tariq (eng-runtime): engineering estimate: runtime changes ~3 dev-weeks to annotate envelopes and a feature flag for sampling. ingestion/aggregation ~2 dev-weeks if we reuse existing metrics pipeline. dashboard + export ~2 dev-weeks. total ~7 dev-weeks across teams.

jin (eng-platform): highlight tradeoffs: we can do cheaper short-term store (1w retention) for interactive dashboards and cold export job to blobstore for long-term. saves cost but UX hit for long-range queries.

emma (design): dashboard sketch: top row: global latency & cost; second: per-route hotspot table with sparklines; row-level quick actions: open trace / export. attaching a tiny ascii mock below:

```
[ Overview ]   total tokens | $ | p50 latency
Route table:
| route | model | today $ | 7d trend | p95 ms | sample trace |
```

sasha (eng-sre): launch criteria suggestion: - accuracy: token accounting within 5% on synthetic workloads; - reliability: telemetry ingestion 99.9% for active nodes; - cost guardrails: default sampling and 1w retention to cap spend; - rollback plan: feature flag per-customer + autoscale off for heavy telemetry.

maria (pm): good. customer-facing asks we must confirm: CS wants a one-click CSV export for last 30 days with customer/team tags. Leo — can you validate with the two trial customers?

leo (cs): will validate — quick heads up: one customer also asked for mapping to billing invoice line items, might need a follow-up.

tariq (eng-runtime): question on model fallbacks: do we need trace spans showing fallback chain? that's extra instrumentation. estimate +1w if we include structured span for each fallback hop.

maria (pm): prioritize basic trace_id that links requests across services in MVP. fallback span can be v2. Keep tradeoff: speed to ship vs. depth of trace.

jin (eng-platform): ops note: ingestion will add to cardinality — keep route labels constrained (no free-form prompt hashes), prefer registered route ids. add validation in ingestion.

emma (design): UI note: customers will want to filter by model variant + quantization profile. can we include variant metadata in envelope?

tariq (eng-runtime): yes, we can emit variant metadata (string) but keep it bounded (enum-like). that'll help dashboards and rollouts.

sasha (eng-sre): security/compliance: ensure telemetry payloads never include prompt text or PII. add unit test and lint in pipeline.

maria (pm): agreed — must be privacy-safe by default. Add to launch checklist.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for telemetry schema change in canary cluster (flagged).

maria (pm): next steps: 1) eng leads to confirm final dev-week split by EOD; 2) CS to validate export asks with customers by Tue; 3) design to upload final mock screens; 4) SRE to propose sampling defaults. I'll run prioritization if scope needs trimming.

leo (cs): I'll ping customers and drop notes in this thread tomorrow.

jin (eng-platform): will post technical design doc draft in #docs by EOD. link once up.

tariq (eng-runtime): started a branch for envelope changes, will open PR and ping for early review.

maria (pm): thanks all — please react with :thumbsup: if you agree to this plan or :eyes: if you still have open questions.
